ideas.pitch: A location-aware web and mobile app that tracks daily mess preparation volumes using simple IoT scales and connects local student volunteers to redirect surplus cooked food before it goes waste.
ideas.problem_statement: Real-world problem statement regarding sustainability and campus resource optimization at Dr. D. Y. Patil Institute of Technology.
ideas.title: CampusCarton: Real-time College Mess Inventory & Surplus Food Redirection System
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines a clear measurable impact with a hyper-local campus problem that judges working and studying at DIT Pimpri can instantly verify and appreciate.

ideas.pitch: An offline-first mobile app for college professors to take secure, spoof-proof attendance using rotating dynamic QR codes combined with precise device GPS bounding.
ideas.problem_statement: Real-world problem statement focusing on campus automation and administrative workflow efficiency.
ideas.title: LocoAttend: Geo-Fenced Cryptographic Attendance & Lecture Engagement Tracker
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves an everyday administrative pain point experienced directly by the faculty judges evaluating the hackathon, guaranteeing immediate empathy and high utility perception.

ideas.pitch: A lightweight dashboard that ingests mock telemetry from campus computer labs to detect abnormal power spikes and predict hardware maintenance failures before they disrupt lab sessions.
ideas.problem_statement: Real-world problem statement around campus infrastructure maintenance and smart automation.
ideas.title: SmartLab: AI-Powered IoT Hardware Fault & Power Consumption Monitor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Demonstrates genuinely hard engineering within a short timeframe by integrating real-time telemetry processing with predictive anomaly detection algorithms.

ideas.pitch: A rapid-response PWA enabling students to trigger emergency alerts with instant audio transcription, auto-translated multi-language support, and precise indoor building coordinates for security staff.
ideas.problem_statement: Real-world problem statement targeting campus safety, accessibility, and emergency response infrastructure.
ideas.title: PimpriSafe: Multilingual Emergency SOS & Campus Incident Dispatcher
ideas.why_it_could_win: Mirrors the success of social-impact and health-awareness tools by addressing critical campus safety needs with accessible multilingual features.

ideas.pitch: An intelligent graph-based matchmaking platform that maps student GitHub repositories, course schedules, and skill tags to automatically form balanced hackathon teams.
ideas.problem_statement: Real-world problem statement focused on student collaboration and project-based learning enhancement.
ideas.title: StudyMesh: Peer-to-Peer Campus Skill & Project Collaborator Matcher
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages graph intelligence patterns seen in top hackathon winners to solve the exact problem every participant faces: finding the right teammates.
